en: The image is a black-and-white, vintage-style photograph showing a large group of children, mostly girls, performing synchronized exercises or gymnastics on a beach. The children are dressed in light clothing and are spread out in rows, stretching their arms. There are adults present, possibly instructors. In the background, the beach extends toward the water and there are more groups of people visible. The bottom of the image contains text in Cyrillic script.
